newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-French yachtsman plucked from liferaft.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-French yachtsman plucked from liferaft.

text.p: French solo yachtsman Thierry Dubois, stranded in a liferaft in the freezing waters near Antarctica, was rescued early on Thursday by an Australian navy helicopter, the Australian Broadcasting Corp radio said, quoting a navy spokesman.
The spokesman said Dubois appeared safe and well.

Australian Defence Force spokesman Colonel Andrew Reynolds told Reuters that Dubois, 29, was plucked from the raft at about 2125 GMT and was onboard the Australian navy frigate HMAS Adelaide about 10 minutes later. His yacht capsized on Sunday.

Reynolds said the frigate was about one to two hours away from the upturned yacht of British sailor Tony Bullimore, 56, whose yacht also capsized on Sunday, and would rendezvous with a civilian tanker to determine how Bullimore might be rescued.
Bullimore is thought to be inside the yacht.
Both yachts capsized in wild seas about 900 miles from Antarctica and 1,400 miles from the Australian coast.
